verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Stir in me
A passion that my heart cannot contain
I come to worship You
Stir in me
A fire that the world cannot explain
I come to worship You

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Hold me, break me
Mold me and make me more and more like You
I come to worship You
To love You, fear You
Draw ever near You as I worship You
I come to worship You

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Whom have I in heaven but You
There is nothing on earth I desire beside You
My flesh and my strength many times they fail
But there is one truth that always will prevail

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
God is the strength of my heart
God is the strength of my heart
God is the strength of my heart
And my portion forever, forever
